# U130 Tube Pressure artwork

One rear label was newly drawn in code from the exact U130 official rear photograph. The product name, MCP-H10-B200KPPN identifier, fixed printed range/supply text and PORT.B signal/blank/5V/GND blocks were rasterized as an ordinary high-resolution PNG. Font, color and registration remain reconstructed visual details. Printed supply/range text does not implement an electrical or pressure model.

The same-model front references show the sensor nozzle, unprinted white shell and native molding. No front sticker was invented. The rear PNG is projected only onto the original recessed physical shell surface; disabling it preserves the enclosure, PCB, sensor package, tube lumen, real ports and screw.

The distributed asset is marked `reference-redraw`. No product photo crop, private table, private download URL, vector original, original filename, generator, intermediate drawing, unreadable identifier, QR or serial number is distributed. Original printed designs and trademarks retain their respective rights. `artwork.json` records public official reference URLs and SHA256 values for the final PNG and reference bytes.
